onboarding.title: Onboarding

problem.title: Sound familiar?
problem.subtitle: You're not disorganized. Subscriptions are designed to be hard to track.
problem.p1: You get charged and don't even know what it's for.
problem.p2: Trials flip to paid while you're looking the other way.
problem.p3: Your Netflix went up $3. You found out on your bank statement.
problem.p4: You're paying for duplicates. Two cloud plans. Three streaming services.

personalize.title: What hits closest to home?
personalize.subtitle: We'll focus on what matters most to you.
personalize.opt1: I'm paying for things I forgot about
personalize.opt4: I just want one place to see everything

solution.body_forgot: We scan your inbox and surface every charge — before it hits your card. Even the ones from 2 years ago.
solution.title_trials: Beat trial traps before they hit
solution.body_trials: We flag every trial about to flip to paid, with the exact date you need to cancel by.
solution.body_prices: The moment a billing email shows a higher amount than last time, we alert you instantly.
solution.body_clarity: Every recurring charge, one screen. Amounts, dates, what to do next. No more hunting.
solution.note: Built for this. Works in 60 seconds.

outcomes.title: Not features. Results.
outcomes.subtitle: Here's what actually changes for you.
outcomes.o1: Know your exact monthly burn before it leaves your account
outcomes.o2: Cancel what you forgot about — in under 60 seconds
outcomes.o3: Never miss a trial ending or a quiet price increase
outcomes.o4: Stop paying for services you don't use anymore
